text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You want to go on a walk... with me?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! I found a spot with a nice<n>breeze blowing!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That does sound refreshing... Oh? I<n>can smell the
scent of flour and butter<n>drifting on the wind coming
from you<n>two...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That would be the treat we<n>finished baking just
now! It's a<n>special homemade cake that—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-that we made because we were<n>thinking we
could have a nice picnic<n>with everyone! Right,
Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, er, yes, exactly! And<n>Flower's decorated
our picnic venue<n>in exquisite floral fashion!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
S-say whaaat? Th-there's no venue!<n>Because it's
not a party, it's just a<n>picnic!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A cake and flowers... it almost sounds<n>like you've
prepared some sort of<n>celebration for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Wh-whatever do you mean?<n>I've never
even heard of a<n>Bakushin-style surprise birthday
party!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Is that so? Then why don't<n>we head on
over to this "picnic"?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(A felicitous breeze blows from their<n>direction... Heh.
It tickles a bit, but also<n>has a comforting warmth.)
